# 2006 Elections

There were 5 elections held in Jersey in 2006.

- **[St Lawrence Connétable Election](https://flow.je/elections/2006#e34)**

  1 seat · Uncontested
- **[St Martin Connétable Election](https://flow.je/elections/2006#e27)**

  1 seat · 3 candidates · Turnout unknown
- **[St Mary Connétable Election](https://flow.je/elections/2006#e35)**

  1 seat · Uncontested
- **[St Ouen Connétable Election](https://flow.je/elections/2006#e36)**

  1 seat · Uncontested
- **[St John Connétable Election](https://flow.je/elections/2006#e37)**

  1 seat · Uncontested

Visit **[Vote.je](https://www.vote.je/)** for official information on the elections.

* * *

* * *

## 2006 St Lawrence Connétable Election

Election for the role of Connétable of [St Lawrence](https://flow.je/elections/st-lawrence) (1 seat), 3rd February 2006.

**[Geoffrey Fisher](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/geoffrey-fisher) was elected as Connétable of St Lawrence in 2006 unopposed**.

#### Sources

- [https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2005/07/27/st-lawrence-deputy-to-stand-down/](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2005/07/27/st-lawrence-deputy-to-stand-down/)

* * *

## 2006 St Martin Connétable Election

Election for the role of Connétable of [St Martin](https://flow.je/elections/st-martin) (1 seat), 28th June 2006.

**[Silva Yates](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/silva-yates) was elected as Connétable of St Martin in 2006**.

## 2006 St Mary Connétable Election

## 2006 St Ouen Connétable Election

Election for the role of Connétable of [St Ouen](https://flow.je/elections/st-ouen) (1 seat), 9th August 2006.

## 2006 St John Connétable Election

Election for the role of Connétable of [St John](https://flow.je/elections/st-john) (1 seat), 7th November 2006.
